overview: The Medford Bicycle Advisory Commission elected new officers, reviewed safety hazards along the Route 16 Auburn Street bridge corridor, and voted to support lowering speed limits on state-owned roads in Medford to 25 miles per hour.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Announcements and Police Outreach
items.summary: Voted to authorize Emily O'Brien to represent the commission in upcoming discussions with the mayor and police chief regarding cyclist harassment, crash reporting, and law enforcement training.

items.title: Election of Officers
items.summary: Elected Daniel Nuzzo-Mueller as Chair and Emily O'Brien as Vice Chair, while voting to postpone the election of a secretary to the January meeting.

items.title: Route 16 Auburn Street Walkthrough Recap
items.summary: Summarized a multi-agency site walkthrough highlighting guardrail crashes, narrow shared paths, and missing signal phases at Route 16 and Auburn Street, followed by a review of state crash cluster data.

items.title: Bluebikes Federal Expansion Grant
items.summary: Noted a $21.6 million regional federal grant allocated through the Metropolitan Area Planning Council for Bluebikes expansion and transit shuttles.

items.title: Infrastructure Updates and State Road Speed Limit Endorsement
items.summary: Voted to endorse lowering speed limits on state-owned roads in Medford to 25 miles per hour, received an update on pending city bike rack installations, and discussed a recent pedestrian crash on Mystic Valley Parkway.
